pregame.whyWatch: Two winning teams: Broncos 2-1, 3rd in the AFC West; 49ers 3-0, 1st in the NFC West.
pregame.pressurePoint: Broncos deep passing vs 49ers secondary. The 49ers are No. 6 of 32 at limiting explosive passes (1.17). The Broncos rank No. 24 in pass explosiveness (1.22). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. Deep balls are the lowest-percentage play in this game. The Broncos need the underneath game and yards after catch. Watch the longest Broncos completion. If it is under 25 yards at the half, the 49ers have won the matchup.
